description: Source code for handling Git identity lines, including functions for generating, parsing, and managing author and committer identity information, as well as related configuration and environment handling.

methods.name: ident_default_name
methods.description: Returns the default name for identification, auto-detected from system info or configuration.

methods.name: ident_default_email
methods.description: Returns the default email for identification, auto-detected or from environment.

methods.name: ident_default_date
methods.description: Returns the default date string for identification.

methods.name: git_author_info
methods.description: Generates author identity string based on environment or configuration.

methods.name: git_committer_info
methods.description: Generates committer identity string based on environment or configuration.

methods.name: author_ident_sufficiently_given
methods.description: Checks if author identity information is sufficiently provided.

methods.name: committer_ident_sufficiently_given
methods.description: Checks if committer identity information is sufficiently provided.

methods.name: prepare_fallback_ident
methods.description: Sets environment variables for fallback author and committer identities.

methods.name: fmt_name
methods.description: Formats a name and email into an identity string with optional date.

methods.name: fmt_ident
methods.description: Creates a formatted identity string from name, email, date, and flags.

methods.name: split_ident_line
methods.description: Parses an identity line into its components (name, email, date, timezone).

methods.name: apply_mailmap_to_header
methods.description: Applies mailmap transformations to email headers in a buffer.

methods.name: git_ident_config
methods.description: Handles git configuration for identity-related variables.

methods.name: ident_cmp
methods.description: Compares two identity components for sorting or equality.
